tools.name: pakish_create_inquiry
tools.description: Persist a hosting inquiry and sales-review handoff only after the person explicitly consents to storage/review. Returns a confidential 24-hour inquiry capability. Does not verify contact, send email or create an order.

idempotency_key.description: Stable UUID for this operation. Reuse on retries; use a new UUID for changed input.

offer_id.description: Stable offer_id from the current catalog, for example pakish.shared-hosting.naya-josh.1yr.

tools.name: pakish_create_quote
tools.description: Persist a current nonbinding quotation using the existing LuraFlow preview for the authorized inquiry. Requires its access token and retry UUID. No order, payment, reservation or checkout handoff; a hold requires staff review.

inquiry_access_token.description: Confidential inquiry access_token returned by pakish_create_inquiry. Capability for this inquiry only; expires after 24 hours. Never put in URLs or logs.

idempotency_key.description: Stable UUID for this operation. Reuse on retries; use a new UUID for changed input.

offer_id.description: Stable offer_id from the current catalog, for example pakish.shared-hosting.naya-josh.1yr.

tools.name: pakish_get_catalog
tools.description: Read three published shared-hosting plans and nine indicative PKR offers, terms and renewal charges. Discovery only; no purchase authority.

tools.name: pakish_get_quote
tools.description: Read a quotation belonging to this inquiry capability. Expiry and current catalog/mapping revision are checked; another inquiry's quote is inaccessible.

inquiry_access_token.description: Confidential inquiry access_token returned by pakish_create_inquiry. Capability for this inquiry only; expires after 24 hours. Never put in URLs or logs.

tools.name: pakish_get_reply_history
tools.description: Read the authorized inquiry's bounded reply history and automation-paused state. Requires that inquiry's confidential capability; no global search or customer lookup.

inquiry_access_token.description: Confidential inquiry access_token returned by pakish_create_inquiry. Capability for this inquiry only; expires after 24 hours. Never put in URLs or logs.

tools.name: pakish_reply_to_inquiry
tools.description: Persist one bounded English/Roman Urdu/Urdu hosting follow-up and receive clarification or a current nonbinding estimate. Three-reply/takeover controls apply. Human/stop requests pause automation. Never sends email or performs account, billing or provisioning actions.

inquiry_access_token.description: Confidential inquiry access_token returned by pakish_create_inquiry. Capability for this inquiry only; expires after 24 hours. Never put in URLs or logs.

idempotency_key.description: Stable UUID for this operation. Reuse on retries; use a new UUID for changed input.
